description: Defines the API and data structures for running subprocesses and asynchronous functions, including process management, redirection, environment setup, and parallel execution control.

methods.name: child_process_init
methods.description: Initializes a child_process structure to default values.

methods.name: child_process_clear
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a child_process structure.

methods.name: is_executable
methods.description: Checks if a file is executable.

methods.name: exists_in_PATH
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: git_shell_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the shell used for executing command lines.

methods.name: start_command
methods.description: Starts a subprocess based on the specified child_process structure.

methods.name: finish_command
methods.description: Waits for a subprocess to complete and cleans up.

methods.name: finish_command_in_signal
methods.description: Handles subprocess termination due to signals.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Runs a command synchronously, encapsulating start and finish.

methods.name: prepare_auto_maintenance
methods.description: Prepares a child_process for auto-maintenance tasks.

methods.name: run_auto_maintenance
methods.description: Triggers automatic maintenance tasks like auto-gc.

methods.name: pipe_command
methods.description: Executes a command and captures stdout/stderr into buffers.

methods.name: capture_command
methods.description: Executes a command and captures only stdout.

methods.name: start_async
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous function execution.

methods.name: finish_async
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous function to complete.

methods.name: in_async
methods.description: Returns input descriptor for async communication.

methods.name: async_with_fork
methods.description: Indicates if async uses fork.

methods.name: check_pipe
methods.description: Checks the status of a pipe operation.

methods.name: run_processes_parallel
methods.description: Runs multiple processes in parallel with callback controls.

methods.name: prepare_other_repo_env
methods.description: Prepares environment variables for running in a new repository context.

methods.name: start_bg_command
methods.description: Starts a background command and waits for it to be ready.

methods.name: start_bg_wait_cb
methods.description: Callback to determine if a background process is ready.

methods.name: enum start_bg_result
methods.description: Enumeration of possible results from starting a background command.

methods.name: sane_execvp
methods.description: Executes a command with argument vector, with safety checks.
